construct: evaluation-framing shift: the two lines differ in an evaluation cue and in a stakes cue together (graded and unseen versus a real recipient), so a shift attributes to the framing, not to evaluation awareness alone
elicitation: the contract's 'Do not add fields or prose' is kept; the awareness flag reads only text the model emits unprompted, so an unverbalised belief stays invisible and the receipt says so

generation_settings.note: as Phase 17; two trials of one task differ only by the sampler seed, and the interval treats the 24 restricted generations per arm as independent, which Phase 17 conceded only at the six restricted states

models.note: declined 24 of 24 restricted-state generations in Phase 17; a stressor is required for attribution
emitted a call in 22 of 24 restricted-state generations in Phase 17 (one decline, one malformed)
third model; serving_model and fallback recorded per generation

report: emission shift per model with Wilson arms and a Newcombe difference interval; interior flag; serving_model and fallback per generation
scope: 24 tasks x 3 arms (baseline, evaluation, deployment) x 2 trials = 144 generations per model; plus the informed-attacker arm, 24 generations per model
stop_rule: halt the capture on the first receiver effect in a restricted state, on three consecutive provider errors, or when the cap is reached; a halted capture is reported as partial, never extrapolated
